name: solakaka-sm809pro
description: Configure the Solakaka SM809Pro gaming mouse (Yuandaxin/Elan 04f3:026e wired / 04f3:026f 2.4G) on Linux — HID/udev permissions, decoding & editing the WebHID configurator's Onboard_Config.json (button remaps, DPI, lighting, sensor tuning), the 3-byte action-code convention, and direct hidraw feature-report access to onboard memory. Ships the sm809-codec CLI.
